description.en: Collects TV usage information for Xiaomi.
description.ms: Mengumpul maklumat penggunaan TV untuk Xiaomi.

effect.en: Xiaomi loses usage reports from this service.
effect.ms: Xiaomi kehilangan laporan penggunaan daripada perkhidmatan ini.

description.en: Reports TV usage statistics to Xiaomi.
description.ms: Melaporkan statistik penggunaan TV kepada Xiaomi.

effect.en: Xiaomi loses usage statistics from this service.
effect.ms: Xiaomi kehilangan statistik penggunaan daripada perkhidmatan ini.

description.en: Shows Xiaomi PatchWall recommendations and promotional content.
description.ms: Memaparkan syor dan kandungan promosi Xiaomi PatchWall.

effect.en: You could lose PatchWall home. Handled by the launcher-swap step.
effect.ms: Anda mungkin kehilangan skrin utama PatchWall. Dikendalikan oleh langkah pertukaran launcher.

description.en: Adds Xiaomi content and recommendations to the home screen.
description.ms: Menambahkan kandungan dan syor Xiaomi pada skrin utama.

effect.en: Mi Channel rows and related home-screen features may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Baris Mi Channel dan ciri skrin utama berkaitan mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Offers Xiaomi live streaming channels.
description.ms: Menawarkan saluran penstriman langsung Xiaomi.

effect.en: Mi TV+ channels become unavailable until restored.
effect.ms: Saluran Mi TV+ tidak lagi tersedia sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Receives screen sharing through Xiaomi MiLink.
description.ms: Menerima perkongsian skrin melalui Xiaomi MiLink.

effect.en: MiLink screen sharing stops working until restored.
effect.ms: Perkongsian skrin MiLink berhenti berfungsi sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Checks for TV system software updates.
description.ms: Memeriksa kemas kini perisian sistem TV.

effect.en: The TV may stop receiving system software updates; protected.
effect.ms: TV mungkin berhenti menerima kemas kini perisian sistem; dilindungi.

description.en: Supports remote buttons and Bluetooth remotes on some Xiaomi TVs.
description.ms: Menyokong butang alat kawalan jauh dan alat kawalan jauh Bluetooth pada sesetengah TV Xiaomi.

effect.en: Remote buttons or Bluetooth remote functions may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Butang alat kawalan jauh atau fungsi alat kawalan jauh Bluetooth mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Provides Xiaomi TV setup features.
description.ms: Menyediakan ciri persediaan TV Xiaomi.

effect.en: TV setup or related system functions may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Persediaan TV atau fungsi sistem berkaitan mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Applies Xiaomi customisation during TV setup.
description.ms: Menggunakan penyesuaian Xiaomi semasa persediaan TV.

effect.en: TV setup or related home-screen features may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Persediaan TV atau ciri skrin utama berkaitan mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Handles live TV and input viewing on supported Xiaomi TVs.
description.ms: Mengendalikan tontonan TV langsung dan input pada TV Xiaomi yang disokong.

effect.en: Live TV or input viewing may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Tontonan TV langsung atau input mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Supports Bluetooth functions on Xiaomi TVs.
description.ms: Menyokong fungsi Bluetooth pada TV Xiaomi.

effect.en: Bluetooth devices, including the remote, may stop working; protected.
effect.ms: Peranti Bluetooth, termasuk alat kawalan jauh, mungkin berhenti berfungsi; dilindungi.

description.en: Provides the Xiaomi game centre SDK service.
description.ms: Menyediakan perkhidmatan SDK pusat permainan Xiaomi.

effect.en: Game centre features using this service stop working until restored.
effect.ms: Ciri pusat permainan yang menggunakan perkhidmatan ini berhenti berfungsi sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides the TV Taobao shopping plugin.
description.ms: Menyediakan plugin membeli-belah TV Taobao.

effect.en: TV shopping through this plugin becomes unavailable until restored.
effect.ms: Membeli-belah TV melalui plugin ini tidak lagi tersedia sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Uploads Xiaomi crash and performance reports.
description.ms: Memuat naik laporan ranap dan prestasi Xiaomi.

effect.en: Crash and performance uploads from this service stop until restored.
effect.ms: Muat naik laporan ranap dan prestasi daripada perkhidmatan ini berhenti sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides the on-screen Xiaomi user handbook.
description.ms: Menyediakan buku panduan pengguna Xiaomi pada skrin.

effect.en: The on-screen handbook becomes unavailable until restored.
effect.ms: Buku panduan pada skrin tidak lagi tersedia sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides the Xiaomi screen recording app.
description.ms: Menyediakan aplikasi rakaman skrin Xiaomi.

effect.en: Screen recording through this app becomes unavailable until restored.
effect.ms: Rakaman skrin melalui aplikasi ini tidak lagi tersedia sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Adds the Xiaomi advertising row to Google TV home.
description.ms: Menambah baris pengiklanan Xiaomi pada skrin utama Google TV.

effect.en: The Xiaomi advertising row stops appearing until restored.
effect.ms: Baris iklan Xiaomi berhenti dipaparkan sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Hosts the Xiaomi OneTrack analytics SDK.
description.ms: Menempatkan SDK analitis Xiaomi OneTrack.

effect.en: Analytics collected through this SDK host stop until restored.
effect.ms: Analitis yang dikumpul melalui SDK ini berhenti sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides the preinstalled Xiaomi TV shopping app.
description.ms: Menyediakan aplikasi membeli-belah Xiaomi TV yang diprapasang.

effect.en: Shopping through this app becomes unavailable until restored.
effect.ms: Membeli-belah melalui aplikasi ini tidak lagi tersedia sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides the preinstalled Xiaomi calendar app.
description.ms: Menyediakan aplikasi kalendar Xiaomi yang diprapasang.

effect.en: The Xiaomi calendar app becomes unavailable until restored.
effect.ms: Aplikasi kalendar Xiaomi tidak lagi tersedia sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides the Xiaomi "Pictorial" wallpaper app, which contains advertising code.
description.ms: Menyediakan aplikasi kertas dinding Xiaomi "Pictorial", yang mengandungi kod pengiklanan.

effect.en: Pictorial wallpapers stop appearing until restored.
effect.ms: Kertas dinding Pictorial berhenti dipaparkan sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides Xiaomi TV self-diagnosis.
description.ms: Menyediakan diagnosis kendiri Xiaomi TV.

effect.en: Self-diagnosis through this app becomes unavailable until restored.
effect.ms: Diagnosis kendiri melalui aplikasi ini tidak lagi tersedia sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Uploads Xiaomi after-sales satisfaction surveys.
description.ms: Memuat naik tinjauan kepuasan selepas jualan Xiaomi.

effect.en: Satisfaction survey uploads from this app stop until restored.
effect.ms: Muat naik tinjauan kepuasan daripada aplikasi ini berhenti sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Provides the Xiaomi Alexa integration bridge.
description.ms: Menyediakan jambatan integrasi Alexa Xiaomi.

effect.en: Alexa features using this bridge stop working until restored.
effect.ms: Ciri Alexa yang menggunakan jambatan ini berhenti berfungsi sehingga dipulihkan.

description.en: Configures automatic installation of Xiaomi partner apps.
description.ms: Mengonfigurasi pemasangan automatik aplikasi rakan kongsi Xiaomi.

effect.en: Partner app auto-installs configured by this package stop until restored.
effect.ms: Pemasangan automatik aplikasi rakan kongsi yang dikonfigurasi oleh pakej ini berhenti sehingga dipulihkan.
